name: SamSWAT's IncreasedFOV (3.11)
teaser: BepInEx plugin that allows increasing the FOV past the default 75 as well as offset the head camera
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
Reupload for 3.11 due to demand - see the original IncreasedFOV modpage

No support given since I am not the author

Available mod settings (Hotkey: F12)

Setting Range (value) Horizontal HUD FOV Value -0.1 to 0.1 (default: 0.05) Vertical HUD FOV Value -0.1 to 0.1 (default: 0.05) Max FOV Value 1 to 150 (Default: 150) Min FOV Value 1 to 149 (Default: 20) ### Comparison image for the HUD offset options

Values used for the altered offset:

  • Horizontal offset: -0.01
  • Vertical offset: 0.065
  • FOV: 80

Installation

  1. Download the mod
  2. Open the archive SamSWAT.FOV.zip with 7-Zip
  3. Drag and drop the BepInEx folder into your main SPT folder (where SPT.Server.exe is)
  4. Profit

Demonstration video (yes, it’s from SAIN, just do what is being shown)
